name: Scheduler

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: The calendar's events. Controlled when EventsChanged has a delegate — the caller owns the collection and must apply drag/resize/click edits back onto it; otherwise the component manages its own working copy internally, seeded from this value.

parameters.name: EventsChanged
parameters.description: Invoked with the updated event collection after a drag, resize, or other edit. Binding this makes Events controlled.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: Which engine renders the calendar. Defaults to FullCalendar, so a consumer that never sets this is completely unaffected. FirstParty renders Lumeo's own Blazor views and loads no third-party calendar JS. It is the only mode that honours Recurrence — the wrapper's serializer branches solely on the legacy DaysOfWeek pair — and the only one with live-region announcements for drag outcomes, week numbers (ShowWeekNumbers), weekend hiding (HideWeekends) and resource columns (supply Resources and select Resource). Parameters NOT yet carried across, stated up front rather than discovered later: SlotDuration is ignored, and the JS-side imperative navigation has no equivalent (the toolbar moves an internal anchor date instead). Everything else on this component maps.

parameters.name: ShowWeekNumbers
parameters.description: Shows an ISO-8601 week-number column in the month view. FirstParty only — the wrapper ignores it.

parameters.name: HideWeekends
parameters.description: Hides the Saturday and Sunday columns in the month view. FirstParty only — the wrapper ignores it.

parameters.name: InitialView
parameters.description: The calendar view shown on mount. Default: Month.

parameters.name: InitialDate
parameters.description: The date the calendar is centered on at mount. Default: today.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Allows events to be dragged and resized. Default: true.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Allows the user to click/drag a date range to select it, raising OnDateSelect. Default: true.

parameters.name: BusinessHours
parameters.description: Shades non-business hours in the time-grid views (maps to FullCalendar's businessHours).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: CSS height of the calendar canvas. Default: "640px".

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: The first day of the week, 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday). Default: 1 (Monday).

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Invoked when an event chip is clicked.

parameters.name: OnDateSelect
parameters.description: Invoked when the user selects a date/time range (click-drag on the grid).

parameters.name: OnEventChange
parameters.description: Invoked when an event's time window changes via drag or resize, alongside EventsChanged.

parameters.name: NowIndicator
parameters.description: Show the current-time indicator line in time-grid views. Default: true. Maps to FullCalendar's nowIndicator option.

parameters.name: SlotMinTime
parameters.description: Earliest visible time slot in time-grid views (e.g. 07:00). Maps to FullCalendar's slotMinTime. Default: 00:00 (FullCalendar shows the full day).

parameters.name: SlotMaxTime
parameters.description: Latest visible time slot in time-grid views (e.g. 22:00). Maps to FullCalendar's slotMaxTime. Default: 24:00 (FullCalendar shows the full day).

parameters.name: SlotDuration
parameters.description: Duration of each time slot row in time-grid views. Maps to FullCalendar's slotDuration (formatted as HH:mm:ss). Default: 00:30:00.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: Optional list of resources (people, rooms, equipment). When provided, events are color-coded by their ResourceId and a legend is rendered above the calendar. Note: this uses Lumeo's color-coding fallback, NOT FullCalendar Premium resource lanes (which require a paid FullCalendar Premium license not bundled here).

parameters.name: EventClassNames
parameters.description: Optional callback that returns extra CSS class names for an event chip. The classes are appended to the FullCalendar event's classNames. Use for conditional styling without touching Color.

parameters.name: EventColor
parameters.description: Optional callback that returns a CSS color string for an event. Applied as backgroundColor / borderColor in FullCalendar. Supersedes Color when both are set; resource color applies as a fallback when neither is set.

parameters.name: OnInitError
parameters.description: Raised when JS initialization fails (e.g. CDN down, FullCalendar threw). The argument is the error message. When raised the component renders an error card instead of the calendar.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes merged onto the root card.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Additional HTML attributes captured and forwarded to the root card.

enums.name: SchedulerView
enums.description: Built-in views exposed by the Lumeo scheduler. Maps onto FullCalendar's dayGridMonth / timeGridWeek / timeGridDay / listWeek view names.

examples.title: Week view (first-party engine)
examples.code:
<SchedulerTimeGridView Events="_events"
                        AnchorDate="_anchor"
                        Days="7"
                        BusinessHours="true"
                        NowIndicator="true"
                        OnEventChange="OnEventChange" />

examples.title: Drop validation (CanDrop)
examples.code:
<SchedulerMonthView Events="_events" CanDrop="ValidateDrop" OnEventChange="OnEventChange" />

@code {
    private SchedulerDropResult ValidateDrop(SchedulerEvent ev, SchedulerScheduleDropContext ctx)
    {
        if (ctx.ProposedStart.Day == 15) return SchedulerDropResult.Reject;
        if (ctx.ProposedStart.Day == 22)
        {
            var snapped = ctx.ProposedStart.AddDays(1);
            return SchedulerDropResult.AcceptWith(new SchedulerDropAdjustment(
                Start: snapped, End: snapped + (ctx.ProposedEnd - ctx.ProposedStart)));
        }
        return SchedulerDropResult.Accept;
    }
}

parameters.name: AnchorDate
parameters.description: The window's start (inclusive). Default: today.

parameters.name: DaysToShow
parameters.description: How many days from AnchorDate to list. Default 30, matching the uploaded demo's "next 30 days" agenda.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: The calendar's events (expanded per occurrence internally via SchedulerRecurrenceExpander).

parameters.name: AnchorDate
parameters.description: The month this grid renders. Only Year/Month are read.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: First day of the week for grid layout. Default Monday.

parameters.name: ShowWeekNumbers
parameters.description: Renders an extra leading column with each row's ISO-8601 week number (ReUI parity — its event calendar exposes a "week numbers" display toggle). Default false: when off, the grid keeps its exact previous 7-column markup, so this cannot shift any existing layout. The number is always the ISO-8601 week (ISOWeek), computed from each row's own THURSDAY. Thursday is ISO's defining day — the week a Thursday falls in IS its ISO week — and every 7-day row contains exactly one Thursday no matter which FirstDayOfWeek the grid starts on. That makes the label independent of the grid's start day, which a naive "first cell of the row" reading is not: in a Sunday-start grid the leading Sunday belongs to the PREVIOUS ISO week, so reading the row's first cell would label most rows one week too low.

parameters.name: HideWeekends
parameters.description: Hides the Saturday and Sunday columns (ReUI parity — its event calendar exposes a weekend-hiding toggle). Default false: with it off the grid renders its exact previous seven-column markup. The 42-cell model is untouched; only rendering and keyboard navigation skip the hidden columns. That matters because arrow navigation moves by raw cell index (+/-1, +/-7) — walking that index across a hidden column would put focus on a cell that is not in the DOM, so navigation runs over the VISIBLE cells instead (see VisibleCellIndices).

parameters.name: MaxVisibleLanes
parameters.description: Max visible pill lanes per day before "+N more". Default DefaultMaxVisibleLanes.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The currently selected date (keyboard focus anchor / agenda-strip driver). Controlled via SelectedDateChanged.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Raised when an event chip is clicked or activated (Enter/Space).

parameters.name: OnDateSelect
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a date (double-click, or Enter/Space on an empty cell).

parameters.name: OnRequestPrev
parameters.description: Bubbles a PageUp (previous month) keyboard request up to the toolbar's own Prev.

parameters.name: OnRequestNext
parameters.description: Bubbles a PageDown (next month) keyboard request up to the toolbar's own Next.

parameters.name: ResolveEventColor
parameters.description: Resolves the effective CSS color for an event chip. Falls back to var(--color-primary).

parameters.name: ResolveEventClassNames
parameters.description: Resolves extra CSS class names appended to an event chip.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Allows events to be dragged to another day. Month has no edge-resize (spec §3.4). Default true.

parameters.name: CanDrop
parameters.description: Fail-closed validation predicate for a day-move drop (spec §3.2), widened to a three-way reject/accept/accept-with-adjustment contract (mirrors ReUI's onEventUpdate) — see SchedulerDropResult. null (default) means no consumer opted in — JS is told via hasCanDrop: false so zero ValidateDrop interop calls happen per drag.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Allows drag-across-cells date-range selection on empty grid background (spec §3.4's Month row — previously entirely absent). Default true.

parameters.name: BusinessHours
parameters.description: Shades non-business days (spec's business-hours regression fix — the first-party views previously had no equivalent at all, unlike the FullCalendar wrapper's BusinessHours toggle). Month has no hour axis, so this shades whole day cells outside BusinessDays. Default false (opt-in, matches the wrapper's own default).

parameters.name: BusinessDays
parameters.description: Which days of the week count as business days when BusinessHours is true. Default Mon–Fri, matching FullCalendar's own hardcoded default.

parameters.name: OnEventChange
parameters.description: Raised after a day-move drag commits (post-CanDrop validation, ghost already removed).

events.description: Raised when the user selects a date (double-click, or Enter/Space on an empty cell).

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: The events to place. Only those whose ResourceId matches a supplied resource are rendered — see Resources.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: The bookable resources, one column each, in the given order. An event whose ResourceId matches none of them is NOT rendered, deliberately: inventing an "unassigned" column would be a layout decision this view has no basis to make, and silently folding such events into the first column would misattribute someone's booking. Callers that want them visible should add a resource to represent that bucket. Duplicate ids resolve to the LAST entry, matching Scheduler's own resource lookup so the two components never disagree about an event's colour.

parameters.description: The single day this view lays out. Only the date part is read.

parameters.name: SlotMinTime
parameters.description: First minute shown on the time axis. Default 00:00.

parameters.name: SlotMaxTime
parameters.description: Last minute shown on the time axis. Default end of day.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Raised when a booking chip is clicked.

parameters.description: Per-event colour override, matching the other first-party views.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: The calendar's events (expanded per occurrence internally via SchedulerRecurrenceExpander).

parameters.name: AnchorDate
parameters.description: Anchor date. Week mode (Days == 7) resolves the containing week via FirstDayOfWeek; Day mode (Days == 1) shows this date only.

parameters.name: Days
parameters.description: Number of day columns: 7 = Week, 1 = Day (spec §1.1). Any other value renders that many columns starting at AnchorDate (wave-3 N-day groundwork, not yet a public view).

parameters.name: SlotMinTime
parameters.description: Earliest visible slot. Default 00:00. Never changes the underlying wall-clock grid math (spec §2.3) — purely a visible-range clamp.

parameters.name: SlotMaxTime
parameters.description: Latest visible slot. Default 24:00.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Allows events to be dragged (move) and edge-resized. Default true.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Allows drag-to-create on empty grid background. Default true.

parameters.name: NowIndicator
parameters.description: Shows the browser-local current-time indicator line (spec §2.2 — positioned and refreshed entirely client-side, never a server-computed value). Default true.

parameters.name: CanDrop
parameters.description: Fail-closed validation predicate for a move/resize drop (spec §3.2), widened to a three-way reject/accept/accept-with-adjustment contract (mirrors ReUI's onEventUpdate) — see SchedulerDropResult. null (default) means no consumer opted in — JS is told via hasCanDrop: false so zero ValidateDrop interop calls happen per drag, not "always permit".

parameters.name: BusinessHours
parameters.description: Shades non-business-hour slots and non-business days (spec's business-hours regression fix — the first-party views previously had no equivalent at all, unlike the FullCalendar wrapper's BusinessHours toggle). Default false (opt-in, matches the wrapper's own default). Grid interval and snap duration remain out of scope for this pass (still hardcoded — see the report).

parameters.name: BusinessHoursEnd
parameters.description: Latest business hour (exclusive) when BusinessHours is true. Default 17:00.

parameters.name: BusinessDays
parameters.description: Which days of the week count as business days when BusinessHours is true. Default Mon–Fri, matching FullCalendar's own hardcoded default.

parameters.description: Raised after a move/resize drag commits (post-CanDrop validation, ghost already removed).

## Events
- `EventsChanged` (`EventCallback<IEnumerable<SchedulerEvent>>`) — Invoked with the updated event collection after a drag, resize, or other edit. Binding this makes Events controlled.
- `OnEventClick` (`EventCallback<SchedulerEvent>`) — Invoked when an event chip is clicked.
- `OnDateSelect` (`EventCallback<SchedulerDateRange>`) — Invoked when the user selects a date/time range (click-drag on the grid).
- `OnEventChange` (`EventCallback<SchedulerEvent>`) — Invoked when an event's time window changes via drag or resize, alongside EventsChanged.
- `OnInitError` (`EventCallback<string>`) — Raised when JS initialization fails (e.g. CDN down, FullCalendar threw). The argument is the error message. When raised the component renders an error card instead of the calendar.
